title: fix(apps): the batch-1 connector apps carry their own iconUrl
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XNmz8nDAYYNgbfKX5CH6cV2)_

Fixes #28588

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：两个首批连接器应用（GitHub、Stripe）各自带上一个包内自有的图标 `assets/icon.svg`，`objectstack.manifest.json` 加上指向它的 `iconUrl`（main 上的 raw.githubusercontent.com 地址，和 HotCRM 的写法一致）。
- **为什么改**：市场审核要求上架有图标；之前两份清单都没有，云端上架脚本只能靠 `--icon-url` 临时补。
- **风险与回滚**：极低。两个包都是 private，不发 npm；只加一个清单键（schema 早已允许）、两张 SVG 和测试。回滚即还原这三处。
- **先看**：`packages/apps/connector-github/objectstack.manifest.json`（新增的 `iconUrl` 行）；`packages/apps/connector-github/test/listing.test.ts`（新增的三个用例）；`packages/apps/connector-github/assets/icon.svg`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/connector-app-github exec vitest run test/listing.test.ts`，预期 8/8 通过；把清单里的 `iconUrl` 行删掉再跑，预期 2 个用例失败。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/apps/connector-github/assets/icon.svg`, `packages/apps/connector-stripe/assets/icon.svg` (new): a neutral connector glyph (a white plug on a rounded square, 256 by 256, the same frame as HotCRM's `assets/icon.svg`), slate for GitHub and teal for Stripe. No vendor artwork.
- Both `objectstack.manifest.json` files gain `iconUrl`: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/main/packages/apps/APP/assets/icon.svg`, with APP the package directory. It resolves once this PR is on `main`; that is the shape the handbook's HotCRM example uses (`content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx`, the worked example).
- Both `test/listing.test.ts` files (extended rather than a parallel file, since they already read the manifest) gain three cases:
  - `carries a public http(s) iconUrl`: the manifest's `iconUrl` is a string that parses as a URL with an `http:` or `https:` scheme. `TemplateManifestSchema` takes any URL scheme, so the scheme is checked in the test.
  - `refuses an iconUrl that is absent or not http(s)`: the control. The same predicate answers a problem for the manifest without the key, for an `ftp:` URL and for a relative path (fixture objects, no file edit).
  - `points iconUrl at the icon this package owns`: the URL is the one above, `assets/icon.svg` exists in the package, it is under the 256 KB bound `--icon-file` uses, and it is a 256 by 256 SVG.

### Icon choice and brand basis

I shipped the neutral glyph for both apps. I could not cite a usage permission for either vendor's logo from this session, and the order says not to download a vendor logo without one, so the card's safe default applies. Both icons are drawn here, from primitives, and carry no vendor mark. The listing still names the vendor in `displayName`; a vendor mark can replace the glyph later in its own PR once someone cites that vendor's published permission.

### Publishing

Both packages are `"private": true`, so nothing reaches npm and this PR carries `skip-changeset`. Package `files` therefore does not apply. The icon is served from the repository tree, which is where the URL points.

## Tests

<details><summary>Red on the base manifests, green at head</summary>

Run per app: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/connector-app-APP exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/listing.test.ts`.

Red leg: head's tests with both manifests restored to base `f23e0512` (tree only, `git restore --source`; `grep -c iconUrl` answered 0 for each):

```
connector-github:  × carries a public http(s) iconUrl
                   × points iconUrl at the icon this package owns
                   Tests  2 failed | 6 passed (8)
                   AssertionError: expected 'iconUrl is absent' to be null
connector-stripe:  × carries a public http(s) iconUrl
                   × points iconUrl at the icon this package owns
                   Tests  2 failed | 10 passed (12)
```

Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- both manifests`; `git diff HEAD` empty afterwards. Green leg: connector-github `Tests 8 passed (8)`, connector-stripe `Tests 12 passed (12)`.

Full package runs at `6bdaa4b1`, under the verify lock, after building the `^...` closure of both apps:

```
pnpm --filter @objectstack/connector-app-github test && ... typecheck   → objectstack validate ok · Test Files 2 passed (2) · Tests 13 passed (13) · tsc --noEmit ok · VERDICT command-exit 0
pnpm --filter @objectstack/connector-app-stripe test && ... typecheck   → objectstack validate ok · Test Files 2 passed (2) · Tests 19 passed (19) · tsc --noEmit ok · VERDICT command-exit 0
```

`tsc --listFiles` includes both `test/*.test.ts` files of connector-github, so the typecheck covers the new cases.
</details>

<details><summary>Local gates</summary>

At head `6bdaa4b1`, the `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derivation for this diff (47 families) plus `check:template-manifests`, each command run in turn with its exit code captured before any pipe. Reconciliation (`--ran`): **47 derived, 46 run with exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun.**

- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it reads the built `dist/` of packages outside this diff's closure, such as `client-react`). The CI run of `Lint & Repo Gates` is its reading.
- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 (its positive-control commit was not in the shallow clone); after `git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a487607881c66b2899b7e3477115229a156b4` it exits 0, 48 cases.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:template-manifests` (outside the derivation, run because it parses every shipped manifest): exit 0.
- Not run locally, CI-owned: `pnpm lint` and the rest of the farm; `test:repo` (no repo-project file touched).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `TemplateManifestSchema.iconUrl` is `z.string().url()`, so it accepts any scheme, while the handbook asks for a public http(s) URL. The per-app test holds the scheme for these two apps. Whether the shelf's later apps should share one rule (or the schema should say http(s)) is the seat's call; this PR adds no repo-wide gate, as the triage ruled.
- Overlap: no open PR touches `packages/apps/connector-*` (search of open PRs naming connector, 3 hits; file lists of #28651 and #28652 read, 0 paths under it).

## Verification

`Clause-②: no` measured: the diff changes two private app manifests, two SVG assets and two test files. No served route, schema, export or published file moves. `Metadata-protocol: none`: no authorable key or accepted value changes; `iconUrl` was already allowed.
